brush.opacity_hint: Less — the line is more transparent: you can see what's under it. It doesn't darken over itself, but two lines over each other do

intro.title: How do you like to draw?
intro.later: You can change the set later in Settings, on the “View” tab.

welcome.title: Hi! This is toonop
welcome.text: A cartoon drawing app that combines simplicity and technology. Want a one-minute look at what's here?

toon.title: Toonio compatibility
toon.text: If you came from Toonio and downloaded your archive, open the .toon file from the toon's folder: “Settings” → “Open file...”, or drag it onto the page.

plugins.title: The editor supports plugins
plugins.text: Add new brushes and tools in one click — the plugin catalog is in “Settings”.

panels.title: Arrange the panels your way
panels.text: On a computer, buttons and widgets can be rearranged however you like: drag them to another panel, a new row, or as a window onto the canvas. “Settings” → “View” → “Edit panels”.

export.title: Export your toon
export.text: Export a toon as GIF or video, and a single frame as PNG.

continue.title: Continue other people's toons
continue.text: Anyone can continue any published toon and add something of their own.

open.title: The editor is open source
open.text: The project follows a philosophy of openness: anyone can remake the editor for themselves or send a change — and it will officially become part of it.
